LABEL: has taster
A IAO:0000115: Relates a tasting event to the person who performed the tasting.

LABEL: has stimulus
A IAO:0000115: Relates a tasting event to the material that was tasted.

LABEL: asserts quality
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste percept assertion to the perceptual taste quality it reports.

LABEL: has intensity rating
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste percept assertion to the intensity value reported for it.

LABEL: on scale
A IAO:0000115: Relates a rating to the scale on which it was recorded.

LABEL: has hedonic rating
A IAO:0000115: Relates a tasting event to the liking score the taster gave the sample.

LABEL: part of session
A IAO:0000115: Relates a tasting event to the session in which it took place.

LABEL: has taster status
A IAO:0000115: Relates a person to their assessed taster status.

LABEL: has genotype assertion
A IAO:0000115: Relates a person to a recorded assertion about their taste-related genotype.

LABEL: stimulus derived from
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste stimulus to the food or beverage class it was prepared from.

LABEL: stimulus contains tastant
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste stimulus to a chemical entity present in it that bears a taste quality.

LABEL: perceived via
A IAO:0000115: Relates a perceptual taste quality to the biological process by which it is perceived.

LABEL: detected by receptor
A IAO:0000115: Relates a perceptual taste quality to a receptor whose activation is established to contribute to perceiving it.

LABEL: has output assertion
A IAO:0000115: Relates a tasting event to a taste percept assertion produced in it.

LABEL: typically associated with diplotype
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taster status to a diplotype that commonly but not invariably produces it. This is a statistical association and deliberately not an equivalence.

LABEL: has diplotype
A IAO:0000115: Relates a person or a study group to the diplotype they carry, or that characterises them.

LABEL: threshold for quality
A IAO:0000115: Relates a threshold datum to the perceptual taste quality whose detection or recognition it measures.

LABEL: rating value
A IAO:0000115: The numeric value of a rating on its stated scale.

LABEL: scale minimum
A IAO:0000115: The lowest value the scale admits.

LABEL: scale maximum
A IAO:0000115: The highest value the scale admits.

LABEL: sample order
A IAO:0000115: The position of this sample in the order presented to the taster, counting from one.

LABEL: is blinded
A IAO:0000115: True when the taster could not identify the sample at the time of tasting.

LABEL: collection date
A IAO:0000115: The date on which a tasting session was held.

LABEL: minutes since preparation
A IAO:0000115: Minutes elapsed between preparing the stimulus and tasting it. Relevant where a quality develops after preparation, as limonoid bitterness does in citrus juice.

LABEL: has profile entry
A IAO:0000115: Relates a kind of food or drink to one line of its taste profile.

LABEL: entry quality
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste profile entry to the perceptual taste quality it reports.

LABEL: entry level
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste profile entry to the ordinal intensity level at which the quality is reported.

LABEL: entry phase
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste profile entry to the phase of the tasting at which the quality is reported.

LABEL: holds for group
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste profile entry to the group of tasters for whom it is asserted to hold.

LABEL: elicited by tastant
A IAO:0000115: Relates a perceptual taste quality to a chemical entity whose presence elicits it.

LABEL: contains tastant
A IAO:0000115: Relates a kind of food or drink to a chemical entity it contains that is capable of eliciting a taste quality.

LABEL: interaction agent
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste interaction to the quality whose presence produces the effect.

LABEL: interaction target
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste interaction to the quality whose perceived intensity is altered.

LABEL: interaction effect
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste interaction to the direction of the effect the agent has on the target.

LABEL: demonstrated with
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste interaction to a chemical entity used as a stimulus in the study that established it.

LABEL: explained by interaction
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste profile entry to a taste interaction that accounts for the level reported.

LABEL: level rank
A IAO:0000115: The position of an ordinal intensity level in the ordering from absent to intense, as an integer from zero to four.

LABEL: source statement
A IAO:0000115: The free-text statement of where a taste profile entry's claim comes from.

LABEL: has evidence type
A IAO:0000115: Relates a taste profile entry to the kind of evidence its claim rests on.

LABEL: interaction condition
A IAO:0000115: The concentrations, matched intensities or reversals under which a taste interaction was observed.

LABEL: group defined by status
A IAO:0000115: Relates a phenotype-defined taster group to the taster status that defines its membership.

LABEL: group defined by diplotype
A IAO:0000115: Relates a genotype-defined taster group to the diplotype that defines its membership.
